jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Product Planning
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Product Marketing
General Summary:
The Product Planning team is looking for a highly motivated leader who can take the success of Qualcomm’s Snapdragon to the next level, driving world leadership in performance, power consumption, and cost-efficient design. The Staff Product Manager, as a member of the Product Planning team, will be a key contributor to the Qualcomm Snapdragon roadmap for all target markets including Handsets, Computing, Automotive, Internet of Things, eXtended Reality, Wearables, Data Center, and others.

The successful candidate will have a combination of technical and business backgrounds in System-On-Chip design and architecture, as well as a high-level understanding of the technology building blocks of a state-of-the-art chipset, such as CPU, GPU, NPU, DSP, multimedia, memory, cellular 5G/6G modem, low power design, thermal management, wireless connectivity, sensors, chiplet architectures, etc.

The Staff Product Manager will work with internal teams, partners and customers to define and promote specifications for the next-generation Snapdragon processors for smartphones, consumer and enterprise computing devices, automotive applications, data center applications, smart glasses, augmented and virtual reality applications, wearables and IoT products.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
- Act as a key contributor to the roadmap for all categories of Qualcomm Snapdragon chipsets: - Participate in synchronizing the Technology IP roadmaps and the Snapdragon product roadmap, in close collaboration with the Technology IP Product Management teams. This workflow is driven by technology inflections, process technology, architecture and partitioning plans, standards, future use cases, extrapolation of trends and competition.
- Contribute to synchronization and alignment between the product roadmaps for the different Business Units, to ensure the most optimal reuse and cross-pollination of technologies among the BUs.
- Identify and anticipate key technology development trends and analyze solutions from Qualcomm’s competitors.
- Update and maintain the Snapdragon roadmap documentation. Communicate it to the executive and other levels of the Qualcomm organization.
- Guarantee the integrity and security of the Snapdragon roadmap data, in accordance with Company Confidential Information procedures.

- Drive the specification of chipsets in the concept phase until a program plan of record is approved at the executive level: - Participate in the definition of a competitive value proposition and high-level product specification, ensuring balance and consistency between the multiple technologies embedded in the system.
- Collaborate with all the Technology Product Management teams to define and recommend options and trade-offs for each technology in the system, taking into account features, performance, power, cost, resources, and program schedule constraints.
- Deliver to and get buy-in from the key decision-makers: Chipset Product Management team and Program Engineering team responsible for the overall chipset PNL and execution.

Required Competencies
- Proven track record of successfully managing large-scale projects, working with people from various groups, managing diverse goals, priorities and personalities in driving a project forward to completion.
- Understanding of mobile processing, multimedia and graphics technologies including a technical perspective (technology fundamentals, industry standards) as well as business perspective (industry players, value chain, ecosystem).
- Strategic planning and vision, competitive analysis, positioning and messaging skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, a can-do attitude in a collaborative, highly dynamic environment, and an ability to lead cross-functional projects without formal reporting relationships.
- Rigor and precision in managing frequently changing, complex, sensitive data.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of Product Marketing, Marketing, Business, Engineering, Communications, or related work experience.
OR
Associate's degree or equivalent degree and 8+ years of Product Marketing, Marketing, Business, Engineering, Communications, or related work experience.
OR
High school Diploma or equivalent and 10+ years of Product Marketing, Marketing, Business, Engineering, Communications, or related work experience.

*Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA
- 5+ years Product Management or related work experience in the wireless communications industry.
- 2+ years working in a large matrixed organization.

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that helped unlock 5G, accelerating connectivity and creating new possibilities that can transform industries, generate jobs, and enrich lives. This is only the beginning. Realizing 5G’s full potential requires inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to create world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age—and this is where you come in.

The Compute Chipset Product Management team is part of QCT’s Product Management organization. The team manages the Windows on Snapdragon portfolio, which includes Snapdragon products used in laptops, notebooks, all-in-one devices, and other compute form factors.

The team’s objective is to synthesize and prioritize technical requirements, define the compute product, silicon, and IP portfolio strategy, and build roadmaps that enable QCT to sustain technology, product, and business leadership. Portfolio development reflects technology evolution, standardization efforts, ecosystem partnerships, device engineering and testing needs, market and product requirements, business opportunities, and the competitive landscape.

This role leads compute chipset products, from market assessment and product definition through silicon and IP roadmap planning, and business justification. Responsibilities include defining product positioning and feature requirements, shaping future silicon and IP investment priorities, partnering with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate technology trade-offs, and aligning roadmap decisions with customer needs, competitive dynamics, platform reuse, cost, power, performance, schedule, and long-term business strategy.

The AI Platforms & Systems Solutions team sits at the center of how next-generation AI comes to life across on-device and hybrid computing. We define the end-to-end hardware–software solutions that turn cutting-edge AI/ML models, agentic experiences, and orchestration runtimes into real products people use every day—fast, efficient, and built to scale.

Our charter spans the full AI stack: from model enablement and inference optimization, to the agentic frameworks and orchestration engines that coordinate work across compute tiers, to the open protocols and specifications that make the broader ecosystem interoperable. We partner deeply with silicon, software, standards bodies, OEMs, and developers to shape not just individual products, but the standards the industry builds on.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier—where systems design, product strategy, and open standards meet. If you are energized by defining what comes next in AI computing and driving it from concept through adoption, you will feel at home here.

Job Description

The AI Platforms & Systems Solutions team defines and delivers the end-to-end hardware–software solutions that power next-generation on-device and hybrid AI experiences, with a strong focus on the Windows AI ecosystem. As Sr. Director, PDM, you will direct a comprehensive product strategy—from conception and definition through end of life—for AI platform products and specifications spanning AI/ML model enablement, agentic systems, orchestration runtimes, and the open protocols and standards that connect the m across local AI accelerators (CPU, GPU, NPU).

You will build and lead a high-performing product team, formulate and execute long-term roadmaps for cost and profit control, and function as a central resource across systems, engineering, standards, quality, marketing, and partner teams. You will set direction, grow talent, and be accountable for the portfolio outcomes of your organization, translating emerging model, agentic, and orchestration trends across the Windows edge-AI stack into a differentiated, defensible product and specification roadmap.

Technical Focus Areas

This role places strong emphasis on the following domains. Candidates should demonstrate depth in several and working fluency across all:

- AI / ML Models: model lifecycle, quantization and optimization, inference performance, and on-device / hybrid deployment trade-offs.

- Agentic Systems: planning, tool use, multi-agent workflows, and the product requirements that make agentic experiences reliable and performant.

- Orchestration: task decomposition, routing, execution, and aggregation across compute tiers, including NPU-first runtime strategies.

- Protocols & Standards: authoring, evolving, and driving adoption of interoperability specifications and open standards across the ecosystem and standards bodies.

- Windows & Edge AI Ecosystem: delivering AI products and services on the Windows ecosystem that leverage local AI accelerators (CPU, GPU, NPU) across the app-to-silicon stack.

- Product & Specification Development: translating system solutions into shippable products and ratifiable specifications with clear KPIs, conformance criteria, and partner enablement.

Windows Ecosystem & Edge AI Experience

The role will partner closely with product management, engineering, program management, business unit, developer relations, and ecosystem teams to align roadmaps, reduce fragmentation, improve software reuse, and accelerate product delivery.

The successful candidate will bring deep domain expertise across operating systems, embedded and edge-computing platforms, open-source software, and the software-hardware interface. This individual must be able to influence effectively in a highly matrixed environment, establish credibility with senior technical leaders, and convert complex platform requirements into clear product priorities and executable roadmaps.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
- Develop and execute software product strategies and roadmaps across Linux, Android, Windows, Chrome OS, and other relevant operating system environments.
- Lead product management for foundational software capabilities, central software architecture, and platform enablement supporting multiple Snapdragon and Dragonwing business segments.
